card.name: The word central before nervous system
card.fires_on: The word "central" (capitalized or not) when it begins the phrase "central nervous system". It appears in section headings and in running text about adverse effects.

modes.label: Section heading
modes.description: "Central" starts a numbered warnings heading such as "Central Nervous System Adverse Reactions".

modes.label: Running text
modes.description: Lowercase "central" in a sentence, just before "nervous system" effects or toxicity.

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce "nervous" next, which completes the phrase "central nervous system".
card.plain: It fires on the word "central" when "nervous system" is about to follow.
